name: How long does it take to tape and mud drywall?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to tape and mud drywall?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration for taping and mudding drywall varies significantly based on the project size, complexity, and drying times between coats. Typically, for a standard room, the process can take anywhere from 3 to 7 days, including application of multiple mud coats and sanding. Factors like humidity, temperature, and the specific type of joint compound used directly impact drying time, which is the most time-consuming part of the process. Larger or more intricate areas will naturally require more time.
